title: RAW UNREVIEWED: crossed picture and text transmission predicts incompatible complete-entry content
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Treat copying of drawings and copying of textual entries as separable production channels. A historically documented witness that moves a recognizably inherited drawing beneath a different heading or entry would create a natural contrast: drawing lineage and textual lineage nominate different complete contents. The point is to test whether a drawing resemblance actually selects the accompanying text, not to label the manuscript from a silhouette. No such crossed witness is presently asserted.

design.mechanism: An illustrated compilation can inherit pictures and textual entries through different exemplars or a finite block transposition, producing a stable picture/text mismatch.
design.unit: Complete same-work entries across at least two externally documented witnesses with independently read headings, body text and image correspondences; the putative mismatch cannot be inferred from modern plant identification alone.
design.contrast: Joint picture-and-text descent versus separate transmission with one prospectively fixed finite transposition; the alternatives require different complete source entry contents and cannot share a free per-page lexicon.
design.prediction: The two histories predict mutually incompatible clusters of named parts, properties and uses in all affected entries, including the destination and displaced counterpart. A later target model must explain the entire paired displacement under one writing grammar; one attractive image match cannot decide the text lineage.
design.scope: RAW source-first proposal only. GDT1158 drawing signatures do not establish textual descent or an actual mismatch. GDT617-621 source entry provenance and IDEA739 rare drawing owner are predecessors; this adds discordant transmission as an identification contrast, not another matching threshold. Requires an actually documented crossed source pair before execution; no new Voynich admission, no target scoring, no default Latin channel, no inherited word gloss. If drawing and text channels remain observationally equivalent, retain both and do not claim content binding.
